entities.name: Inés Arrimadas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Inés Arrimadas García is a Spanish lawyer and former politician who served as Member of the Congress of Deputies and Spokesperson of Citizens party in the Congress. She was previously the leader of the regional branch of the party in Catalonia. In March 2020, she was voted party leader.

entities.summary: Inés Arrimadas García is a Spanish lawyer and former politician who served as Member of the Congress of Deputies and Spokesperson of Citizens party in the Congress.
